summary.name: Skeuomorphism (Digital and 3D Aesthetics). This is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Interface elements resemble specific physical controls, materials and mechanisms, such as knobs, scales, buttons and levers. Lighting, edges and shadows must match across the scene. Labels stay readable, and the physical resemblance must serve a functional purpose rather than decoration.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to interface concepts where physical resemblance helps users operate the product. Listed best-fit uses are audio plugin UIs, hardware companion apps, tutorials and premium hardware simulators, the last when paired with prerendered material plates. Other uses are inferred and unverified.
summary.limitations: Avoid decorative textures without function, low-contrast engraved labels, mismatched lighting and heavy image weights on mobile. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production or validated physics. The source frame review sampled only one frame per second from 1 to 8 at medium confidence, so continuous motion, audio and later scenes are unverified.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, so #E7DFD0 is only an illustrative swatch; choose the backdrop from subject, lighting and mood. Foreground #3A352D and accent #8B7151 are authored suggestions, not approved exact colors, and task-provided colors override them. Foreground on background measures 9.185:1. The accent as background (3.465:1) is decorative only. Gradients are disabled, and tokens apply only to new presentation elements.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Presses and rotations must align with the resulting state change, and every interaction needs visible state feedback. Use smooth authored movement while preserving deliberate cuts and impacts. Interactive knobs can act as ARIA sliders with arrow-key steps and a focus ring. Optional references are motion-011 (tilt), motion-012 (chapter handoff), motion-013 (card track), motion-015 (story steps), motion-017 (exploded reveal, only for separable parts) and motion-021 (orbit, only with real 3D); selecting none is valid.
summary.audio: The style mandates no audio layer. Music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience or silence are task-specific choices, and silence is valid. Sound effects can clarify presses or state changes when the topic benefits. Any narration needs intelligible speech and no competing vocals. No source audio was verified, and no soundtrack is supplied.
summary.assetRequirements: No specific asset files are mandated. Prerendered material plates (knob sprites or metal and leather textures) are optional for complex controls, and labels stay live DOM text with lighting matched to CSS shadows. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Subject, exact copy, control inventory and dimensions are unspecified and must come from the task.
summary.combinations: Skeuomorphism alone suits simpler interface concepts. The style-095 hybrid adds state-change timing and feedback motion, so each press or rotation maps to a timed readout change. The style-061 hybrid adds prerendered photoreal plates for premium hardware. Both hybrids require matched lighting, readable labels and function-first design.
summary.productionApproach: HTML/CSS and SVG are the style renderers for controls, materials, labels and masks. GSAP is the motion engine with one owner per animated property, and Motion is optional. HyperFrames is the default pipeline, using data-composition-id, window.__timelines registration, check, snapshot and render. Remotion is used only with a recorded reason. chroma-js is optional for palette checks, and seeks, decoded frames and composited contrast must be verified.
